severity_semantics.HIGH: Promotion-blocking causal, security, integrity or system-level risk requiring closure or an explicit non-promotion decision.
severity_semantics.MEDIUM: Actionable behavior or evidence gap that can invalidate the bounded promotion target if not closed.
severity_semantics.LOW: Bounded limitation that does not independently block the stated candidate outcome.

findings.title: Official host skill-load and causal composition event is not observable
findings.baseline_source: Phase 8 official Phase 4 receipt and host adapter capability report
findings.description: The supported app-server protocol can be invoked, but the current bounded READ_ONLY host path exposes no verifiable skill-load event. A host response or transport success alone does not establish that the frontend capability was loaded or caused the artifact.
required_closure: A supported host-load event bound to the exact capability, or

An independently reviewed observable alternative causal chain with exact task/run/invocation IDs, authorization, workspace, monotonic timestamps, pre/post digests, changed-file list, source/artifact/browser/verifier/final-verification digests, no alternate producer/manual mutation and global mutation count zero.

limitations: Exact artifact copy is the only bridge mutation; global mutation count is zero.

findings.revalidation_trigger: Any change to host protocol, workspace policy, invocation adapter or composition-proof inputs.

findings.title: URL-persisted filter state is not yet runtime-proven
findings.baseline_source: Phase 8 pilot source inspection and zero Phase 8.1 runtime evals
findings.description: The Phase 8 pilot keeps the urgency filter in memory and has no current evidence for URL persistence, invalid URL fallback or back/forward restoration.
required_closure: Valid URL filter initializes the control and visible rows
Filter changes update URL state without losing scenario state
Invalid URL state falls back safely and is recorded
findings.revalidation_trigger: Any routing, filter, history or query-string change.

findings.title: Stale response protection is not yet runtime-proven
findings.baseline_source: Phase 8 source contains a request-number guard but no deterministic stale-response browser receipt
findings.description: The source has a stale-response guard, but the Phase 8 packet contains no fresh browser run that proves an older delayed queue response cannot overwrite a newer response.
required_closure: Deterministic delayed request A and fast request B
Final UI contains only B data
Network/timeline evidence binds both requests and the stale discard
findings.revalidation_trigger: Any queue loading, request cancellation, retry or state update change.

findings.title: Keyboard and focus behavior is not yet fully runtime-proven
findings.baseline_source: Phase 8 static contracts and zero Phase 8.1 runtime evals
findings.description: Static labels and focus styles exist, but the Phase 8 packet does not contain a fresh runtime traversal, submit-error focus, retry focus or visible-focus observation bound to the final artifact.
required_closure: Keyboard traversal reaches all actionable controls in a logical order
Blank/invalid submission focuses the first invalid field
Retry and row actions remain keyboard reachable
Visible focus and error association are recorded
findings.revalidation_trigger: Any DOM order, form validation, focus management or control-state change.

promotion_rule: Do not promote while any promotion_blocking finding is OPEN; a waiver is not a PASS.
